name: Bryon Capella
source:
The son of a marquis.
That he'll succeed his father and become one of the country's leaders in the future has already been decided.
Seems like an unserious bohemian but it's hard to tell what he's really thinking.
He can understand his sister Lilley's choice to become a maid.
Again on his sister's influence, he has no hesitation in declaring himself a fan of the heroine.
